g.text: Same total count, different binding profiles
BPNet separates signal amount from spatial shape. A count-only target misses the difference.
Three-bin simplification of a base-resolution target; natural-log loss, constant terms omitted.
Schematic / worked example · not experimental data · ickma.dev
